# Portable PDB library example

The source application calls an actual SDK-built managed library converted through the MSIL compiler. Its adjacent Portable PDB and original C# source are carried in the NuGet fixture. The generated `library.binary.json` is derived from `tests/fixtures/pdb/Probe.1.0.0.nupkg.base64`; it must not point at a ref-only assembly or substitute JavaScript.

Enable Develop tools, open a read-only [symbol] source, and set a breakpoint inside Probe.Sum. Disable native breaks for snapshot reporting or open browser DevTools for native pause/stepping. Run DLL sum invokes the converted implementation. Release builds omit symbol hooks and embedded original-source maps.

See docs/milestone-portable-pdb.md and docs/core-development-tools.md.
